Inside Macintosh: Cyberdog Programmer's Kit / Part 3 - Cyberdog Reference
Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberProgressPartExtension

GetAttachedProgressBroadcaster

Retrieves the progress broadcaster attached to this progress part. 
CyberProgressBroadcaster GetAttachedProgressBroadcaster ();
return value
The progress broadcaster attached to the progress part.
DISCUSSION
This method returns the broadcaster that is currently attached to a progress part, if any.

If you subclass CyberProgressPartExtension, you must override this method. Your override must not call its inherited method; that is, your override method must implement this method's functionality completely.
